description: Consumer  Affairs Authority - Maximum Retail Price of Rice
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for specific rice varieties and rescinds a previous order. The content focuses entirely on regulatory compliance requirements and price controls, falling squarely under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
